text:
alejandro: Heads up — our Next.js mini starter (LlamaIndex bootcamp) is flaking in the edge runtime during the eval harness run. Repro below.

michelle: Seeing this too on my laptop and CI. Intermittent 401 -> immediate retry yields 429. Only when deployed to Vercel edge.

sam: Can you paste the minimal repro? Is it the JS SDK or fetch wrapper?

alejandro: Minimal repro in /examples/next-mini-llamaindex: using @redwood/sdk-js v0.9.1, edge runtime, middleware that injects token from cookie. Logs: 
```
ERROR auth: 401 Unauthorized — token missing
retrying request -> 1
ERROR rate: 429 Too Many Requests
```
No explicit rate limit on our side. Sometimes first call succeeds then subsequent immediate eval calls fail.

grace: Curious — Python SDK tests against the same eval harness don't show this. Feels like a JS client behavior under keep-alive or connection pooling.

michelle: I tried toggling keepAlive: false in the SDK client options and the failures dropped in half. Not a full fix though.

alejandro: Also noticed when we run the eval harness locally without `edge` target (node runtime) it's stable. So runtime + SDK combo.

oliver: Filing an issue and PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/4582 — added a failing test that reproduces on Vercel edge. Includes minimal curl + fetch traces.

sam: Quick workaround suggestion for bootcamp: add a small backoff on the eval harness orchestrator and bump the SDK to 0.9.2-rc which has a keepAlive tweak. Also add a note in the sample README about "edge quirks".

alejandro: Patch I'm trying in examples:
```js
// next-mini/examples/api/handler.js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/sdk-js'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, keepAlive: false })
// simple exponential backoff inside eval loop
```

grace: Can we add an automated smoke test in CI that deploys the sample to vercel-preview and runs the eval harness? If it flakes we'll catch it before PRs land.

oliver: Agree — created ticket in infra board. Also adding a tiny heartbeat request to warm auth path before full eval to reduce first-call auth race.

michelle: For onboarding, add a troubleshooting section: "If you see 401/429 in edge: try keepAlive: false, increase retry backoff, upgrade SDK." That should reduce support noise from bootcamp attendees.

devbot: CI | deploy-preview #2895 finished (failed smoke): https://ci.internal/redwood/2895 — logs attached.

alejandro: Thanks — I'll land the README note + the example change. Oliver, can you attach the failing test to the issue so we don't lose it?

oliver: Done. PR #4590 opened with example change + README note. Requesting review from @michelle and @grace. :+1:

sam: Nice. After PR merges, let's tag the sample with "known edge-workaround" so bootcamp attendees see it up front.

alejandro: Sounds good. Follow-ups: add CI smoke deploy, merge PR, and plan a deeper SDK parity investigation (JS vs Python behavior under edge).
